Takes an effect out of the chain of its bus and frees it. A reverb or echo tail that was still ringing is cut. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

```blitzbasic
FreeAudioEffect muffle
```
@param effect  An effect from [AddAudioEffect](AddAudioEffect). `0` is ignored, anything else that is not an effect is a runtime error.
@gap Every [audio scene](Audio-Scenes) forgets the effect, so an old scene never changes the effect that gets the same handle later. [FreeAudioBus](FreeAudioBus) frees the effects of the bus too.
